about: Short attribution lines for the sources in CREDITS.md. Used by the viewer (site/app.js) and the Anki decks (tools/build_decks.py). A scene's sources are the 'credit' ids of the meshes it declares, plus any listed under extra.

zanatomy.text: Z-Anatomy (G. Kervyn, M. Zielinski et al.), after BodyParts3D (DBCLS)

rodero-heart.text: Rodero et al. 2021, average adult heart (doi:10.5281/zenodo.4593739)

dundee-cahid.text: University of Dundee CAHID, Cranial Nerves and Foramina (via Z-Anatomy)
